sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A timed escape, not a fight — outrun a ghostly mob through the woods and light the brazier at the far end. Hard fail if it takes longer than 2 minutes.

sections.heading: What to do
bullets: Someone carries the spectral torch the whole way — don't drop it, and don't let the carrier die.
Keep moving. Getting crippled is the main way squads fall behind the mob and fail the timer.
Angered spirits are scattered through the woods — avoid fighting them, just keep running.
